# Quit Smoking Hub Data Center

The evidence and knowledge infrastructure behind Quit Smoking Hub: structured research
records, guideline comparisons, medication and withdrawal science, definitions,
controversies and community data documentation. Educational information; not medical advice.

## Core sections

- Research Database: https://data.smokingcessationhub.com/research/ — 17 research records (Cochrane, NEJM, WHO, NICE)
- Guidelines: https://data.smokingcessationhub.com/guidelines/ — WHO 2024, USPSTF 2021, NICE NG209, US PHS 2008
- Withdrawal: https://data.smokingcessationhub.com/withdrawal/ — cravings, irritability, anxiety, low mood, sleep, concentration
- Medications: https://data.smokingcessationhub.com/medications/ — NRT, cytisine, varenicline, bupropion
- Definitions: https://data.smokingcessationhub.com/definitions/
- Controversies: https://data.smokingcessationhub.com/controversies/ — e-cigarettes, dual-use, gradual vs abrupt
- Community Data: https://data.smokingcessationhub.com/community-data/ — statistics and documentation
- Behaviour Change: https://data.smokingcessationhub.com/behavior-change/
- Health Effects: https://data.smokingcessationhub.com/health-effects/
- References: https://data.smokingcessationhub.com/references/

## Main site

- Quit Smoking Hub: https://smokingcessationhub.com/ — practical guidance, methods compared, experiences
